versions.name: Camp Owen J. Brorein
versions.summary: Greater Tampa Bay Area Council's oldest camp, in Odessa, Florida northwest of Tampa, hosting Cub Scout programs and year-round weekend and troop camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the community scout-camp-map project. Confirmed as a current Greater Tampa Bay Area Council camp (its oldest, est. 1923) against the council's camp listing (the source's gulfridgecouncil.org link is a dead domain). Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate); elevation from the open-meteo DEM. Features not yet surveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; hosts Cub Scout programming; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively; features unsurveyed.
